surfaceLadder.purpose: The recessed page plane. Nothing floats free on it.
Its own step between L0 and L1, with a hairline right edge.
Cards, tables, top bar, secondary buttons.
Chips, header bands, note strips. Inset, never outer-shadowed.

display.purpose: Page-level headings only. Figtree 700 - v2 is one step lighter than v1's 800.

headline.purpose: Card headers - 0.78x display, its own step.

body.purpose: All running text and form content.

label.purpose: Eyebrow labels, badge text, field labels. Uppercase where used, +0.03em.

mono.purpose: Codes, counts, hours and solver expressions - so numbers read as data, not prose.

radius.name: control
radius.purpose: Inputs, selects, textareas, inner bordered boxes.

radius.name: chip
radius.purpose: Badges, tinted chips, roster shift chips.

radius.name: pill
radius.purpose: Buttons, nav items, segmented controls, status pills.

radius.name: none
radius.purpose: Every data surface: tables, roster cells, coverage grid cells, legend swatches, full-bleed bars, top bar.

shadows.name: sh-1
shadows.purpose: L1 resting elevation: cards, tables, top bar, secondary and primary buttons.

shadows.name: sh-2
shadows.purpose: Selected or hovered L1: current step, active editor, button hover.

shadows.name: sh-3
shadows.purpose: L2 raised: dialogs, popovers, toast. Aliased by shadow-dialog and shadow-toast.

shadows.name: sh-well
shadows.purpose: Inset wells. Never an outer shadow.

shadows.name: sh-side
shadows.purpose: Specialized directional overlay for side drawers and mobile navigation only.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for all state transitions.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action. Accent fill, pill shape, resting sh-1 that flattens on :active.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0b7d68; color: #ffffff; padding: 0 16px; height: 36px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(60,55,45,.05), 0 2px 8px rgba(60,55,45,.05); transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #096755; } .ds-btn-primary:active { box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b7d68; outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action. A real L1 surface fill with a hairline and sh-1 - never a transparent outline, which does not read as pressable on the recessed page.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fcfefd; color: #332e2b; padding: 0 16px; height: 36px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #e0e3da; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(60,55,45,.05), 0 2px 8px rgba(60,55,45,.05); transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f9fbfa; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(60,55,45,.06), 0 10px 24px rgba(60,55,45,.09); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b7d68; outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Delete/remove actions. One of only two paired solid semantic fills; always uses the paired on-error token rather than hardcoded white.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { background: #bd4a28; color: #ffffff; padding: 0 16px; height: 36px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 999px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(60,55,45,.05), 0 2px 8px rgba(60,55,45,.05); transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: #9e3d1c; } .ds-btn-destructive:active { box-shadow: none; } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #0b7d68; outline-offset: -1px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard text field. Control radius, hairline border, accent focus ring reinforcing the global focus-visible outline. Grows to at least 44px on coarse pointers.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #fcfefd; color: #332e2b; border: 1px solid #e0e3da; border-radius: 12px; height: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; outline: none; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #9d938c; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #0b7d68; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(11,125,104,0.3); } @media (pointer: coarse) { .ds-input { height: 44px; } }

components.name: Card
components.description: L1 container: surface tone, card radius, warm hairline and a resting sh-1. Tone carries the separation; the shadow only confirms it. A selected card swaps the hairline for a brand border and lifts to sh-2.
components.html:
Shift type
Day 07:00-19:00, 12h, minimum 3 nurses.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fcfefd; border: 1px solid #e0e3da; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(60,55,45,.05), 0 2px 8px rgba(60,55,45,.05); } .ds-card-header { font-family: 'Figtree', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.015em; padding: 20px 20px 4px; color: #332e2b; } .ds-card-body { padding: 0 20px 20px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #57504b; } .ds-card[data-selected] { border-color: #0b7d68; box-shadow: 0 2px 4px rgba(60,55,45,.06), 0 10px 24px rgba(60,55,45,.09); }

components.name: Well
components.description: Inset panel nested inside an L1 card - header bands, note strips, chip trays. Used instead of stacking two surfaces of the same tone. Inset shadow only; never an outer one.
components.css: .ds-well { background: #eef3f0; color: #57504b; border-radius: 9px; box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(60,55,45,.05); padding: 12px 14px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Semantic status indicator. Tint fill, matching semantic ink and border so meaning never depends on hue alone. Reads as text (DONE / CURRENT / TO DO) - no check glyphs, no leader dots.
components.css: .ds-badge-success { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #e2f1ea; border: 1px solid #1f6b52; color: #1f6b52; border-radius: 9px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }

components.name: Success Toast
components.description: Signature component. Bottom-centre, ink fill with on-ink text, a leading check mark and the raised sh-3. v1's green 3px left-edge rule is retired along with the side-stripe exception that justified it - this system has no side-stripe exception at all.
components.css: .ds-toast { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #332e2b; color: #fbf9f7; border: none; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 20px 50px rgba(60,55,45,.22); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 16px; } .ds-toast-icon { color: #63c79e; }

narrative.overview: A rostering instrument for nurses on shift, used at the start and end of long days by people doing an admin chore they did not ask for. Both halves of the name are load-bearing. Warm lives in the ink and the hairlines: type is warm espresso (#332e2b) and never pure black, borders are warm-tinted, shadows are brown rather than neutral grey, controls round and touch targets are generous - this is what stops the tool reading as cold clinical software. Mint lives in the canvas: the page is a cool recessed mint (#f3f6f4) that keeps the app awake and clean, because a fully warm-on-warm scheme was built first and read as dinge under ward lighting. And it stays clinical, because this is an instrument and not a wellness app: dense data stays dense, the roster grid stays a crisp grid, numbers are monospaced and aligned, and nothing decorative goes onto a data surface. The single most important structural rule is the surface ladder - every surface belongs to a named level, and level is expressed by tone first, shadow second.
keyCharacteristics: Warm espresso ink ramp on a cool mint canvas. No true black anywhere - a control rendering rgb(0,0,0) is a bug.
A stepped L0 to L2 surface ladder with a warm shadow ramp. Tone carries separation; shadow only confirms it.
Rounding is warmth, not a theme: cards 16px, controls 12px, chips 9px, buttons and nav pills 999px - but tables, roster cells and full-bleed bars stay square.
One user-selectable accent (teal default, plus sage, rose and plum), each with separately audited light and dark values; status colour is reserved for meaning only.
Figtree 700 for display/headings, Hanken Grotesk for body/UI, Spline Sans Mono for codes, counts, hours and solver expressions.
A fluid type scale stepping at six breakpoints, baked at a fixed 0.9 density multiplier. The prototype's live Compact/Comfortable/Spacious knob is deliberately not shipped.
Radius and shadow values are absolute px and are NOT multiplied by 0.9. Only spacing and type ride the multiplier.
Two independent, deliberately disjoint breakpoint ladders: type and layout - never conflate them.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Exactly one accent is live at a time, user-selected from four. The selection maps to its theme-specific --brand; --brandink and --brandtint derive from that active value and --chrome aliases it. Never hand-author a fifth accent at a consumer.

rules.name: The Redundant Signal Rule
rules.body: Status is never carried by colour alone: every status badge pairs its tint with a matching semantic ink and border, and status text says what it means (DONE, not a check glyph).

rules.name: The No-Black Rule
rules.body: Nothing inherits the UA default black. Buttons do not inherit colour by default, so the shell must set button { color: inherit }. Any control rendering rgb(0,0,0) is a bug.

rules.name: The Negative-Tracking Rule
rules.body: Every heading-weight face carries -0.015em letter-spacing; every uppercase label carries +0.03em. Never leave a heading at default tracking or a label un-tracked. The global h1-h6 rule in globals.css is the safety net that guarantees the heading half.

rules.name: The Surface Ladder Rule
rules.body: Every surface belongs to a named level (L0 page, sidebar, L1 surface, L2 raised, well), and level is expressed by tone first, shadow second. Resting cards and secondary buttons carry sh-1; this reverses v1's flat-by-default doctrine.

rules.name: Direction of Light Is Fixed
rules.body: A well never has an outer shadow; a raised surface never has an inset one. Dark mode inverts the direction, not the ladder: wells go darker than their surface, raised surfaces go lighter.

rules.name: Never Stack Two Levels of the Same Tone
rules.body: An L1 card inside an L1 card becomes a well instead.

rules.name: The Square Data Rule
rules.body: Rounding marks where the hand goes, not where the data is. Tables, roster cells, coverage grid cells, legend swatches, full-bleed bars and the top bar stay square.

dos: Do put every surface on a named ladder level, and express level by tone first, shadow second.
Do round cards (16), controls (12) and chips (9), and pill every button and nav item.
Do keep tables, roster cells, coverage grid cells, legend swatches and every full-bleed bar square.
Do give secondary and ghost buttons a real surface fill with sh-1 - a transparent outline on the recessed page does not read as pressable.
Do pick the right semantic tier: base on its own tint, ink for the deepest treatment, and paired warn/error fill plus on-token only for exceptional solid actions.
Do use warm brown-tinted shadows in light mode, black at higher alpha in dark.
Do pair every status colour with matching ink and border so meaning never depends on hue alone.
Do route every new component through the tokens above - no hard-coded hex, no default shadcn blue.
Do use the layout ladder (600/720/760/900/1100/1200px) for grid/form breakpoints and the type ladder (480/768/1024/1280/1440/1920px, plus the 920px nav pivot) for everything else.
Do multiply spacing and type by the 0.9 baseline - and not radius or shadow, which are absolute.
donts: Don't use pure black, or let a control inherit the UA default rgb(0,0,0).
Don't round a data structure - no soft-blob tables, roster cells or full-bleed bars.
Don't hardcode white on a semantic fill; use the paired on-token.
Don't put an outer shadow on a well or an inset shadow on a raised surface.
Don't stack two surfaces of the same tone - nest a well instead.
Don't use --panel for zebra striping; that tone is reserved for header bands and true insets. Use --panel-alt.
Don't use --brandtint plus a --brand border for anything but selection.
Don't ship a generic SaaS dashboard cliche - no gradient hero metrics, no glowing stat tiles, no glassmorphism-as-default.
Don't make it read as cold clinical hospital software - sterile and intimidating is a failure state.
Don't introduce playful-consumer-app cues - no mascots, no bright primaries outside the defined palette, no everything-rounded.
Don't let anything look like an unstyled shadcn default.
Don't use a colored left/right border stripe as a decorative accent - this system has no side-stripe exception.
Don't use gradient text or any background-clip: text treatment.
Don't snap a layout grid to the nearest type-ladder breakpoint instead of its own layout-ladder value.
